mapper.select: SELECT type AS type, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{todayStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayCnt FROM ledger_transaction WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY type
SELECT 'asset' AS accountKind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ledger_asset_account WHERE status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'liability' AS accountKind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ledger_liability_account WHERE status = 1
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ledger_budget) AS budgets, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ledger_net_worth_snapshot) AS snapshots, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM ledger_transaction) AS activeUsers

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fail, COALESCE(SUM(token_used), 0) AS tokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost_yuan), 0) AS costYuan FROM ai_execute_log
SELECT COUNT(*) AS todayTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayFail FROM ai_execute_log WHERE create_time >= #{todayStart}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finished, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unfinished, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'finished' AND score IS NOT NULL THEN score END), 1), 0) AS avgScore, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{todayStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayNew FROM portal_voice_interview

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'accepted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS accepted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{todayStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayNew FROM portal_interview_submission WHERE del_flag = '0'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'published' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS published, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'draft' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS draft FROM portal_user_resume WHERE del_flag = '0'
SELECT task_type AS taskType, status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM portal_ai_task GROUP BY task_type, status

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portal_growth_log) AS growthLogs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portal_user_growth WHERE level IS NOT NULL AND level > 0) AS leveled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portal_user_badge) AS badges

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portal_comment WHERE del_flag = '0') AS comments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portal_topic WHERE del_flag = '0') AS topics, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portal_column WHERE del_flag = '0') AS columns, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portal_tag WHERE del_flag = '0') AS tags, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portal_user) AS portalUsers

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ledger_transaction WHERE status = 1 AND create_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM portal_voice_interview WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT platform_code AS platformCode, platform_name AS platformName, platform_type AS platformType, description AS description, domain AS domain, icon AS icon, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM sys_platform WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE del_flag = '0') AS sysUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role WHERE del_flag = '0') AS sysRoles

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN audit_time >= #{todayStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayHandled FROM sys_audit_task
